title: RPA DNA Amplification using TwistAmpTM Basic
author: Luc Gabel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8erhtd6

steps.title: Prepare RPA pellet rehydration solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the RPA pellet rehydration solution in a 1.5 ml tube according to the Materials section table, creating a Master Mix if possible for subsequent division.

steps.title: Resuspend reaction pellets
steps.instruction: Transfer 47.5 µl of the rehydration solution to each reaction pellet and pipette up and down until the pellet is fully resuspended.

steps.title: Add Magnesium Acetate
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 µl of 280mM MgOAc to the cap of each reaction tube to ensure simultaneous reaction start upon spinning.

steps.title: Initiate reaction
steps.instruction: Perform a short spin to drop the MgOAc into the tube, vortex briefly, and perform another quick spin.

steps.title: Incubate samples
steps.instruction: Incubate the reactions at 39°C for 20 minutes.

substeps.instruction: For low copy numbers: incubate for 4 minutes, vortex, spin briefly, and incubate for an additional 16 minutes.

steps.title: Purify RPA product
steps.instruction: Purify the sample if the product is to be run on an agarose gel, using a PCR purification kit with a high cutoff due to long primers (60+ bp).

substeps.instruction: Ensure post-amplification reactions are not opened in the pre-amplification workspace to prevent DNA contamination.
